description: Gets the style breakdown of one published AIKIZI decode: title, styles, style DNA, subjects, moods, key tokens, color hues, the generation prompt, a small preview image and the aikizi.com link. preview_image_url is the decode’s own picture on AIKIZI: when showing the picture, show that one, never a similar image from the web. Takes the id from search_styles or an aikizi.com/decode/<id> link. Read-only; no sign-in needed. Example: {"id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}. In the chat its answer shows as the AIKIZI decode card, with the decode’s own picture and full breakdown.

id.description: A decode id (UUID) or an https://aikizi.com/decode/<id> link

name: get_style_decode
title: Get a public AIKIZI decode
